answers.core: The feature should be in the core to replace each `String` that the "user can modify and is auto-translated" with `LocalizedString`, as the **editor's** feature to preview locales will work along with `LocalizedStrings`.
answers.workaround: Part of it can be implemented by scripting, but the full solution requires built-in types like `Label` and `Button` to also use `LocalizedStrings`.

title: Add `LocalizedString` type for in-editor locale preview
